summary: Auth regression run executed for backend + frontend. Backend auth/role suite passed 9/9 with fresh pytest coverage. Frontend mobile-web checks validated login/register validation, invalid-credential error display, student-only registration messaging, and successful post-register navigation to student dashboard, but full end-to-end UI auth flow could not be fully completed in this run due Playwright route/state assertion instability.

integration_issues.flow: Playwright full auth journey (session persistence + logout + cross-role redirects in one run)
integration_issues.issue: Automation run became state-inconsistent after route assertions (Expo web path normalization to /dashboard, /login), so remaining checks could not be conclusively completed in this iteration.

action_items: Main agent should run one deterministic Playwright pass using actual resolved web paths (/login, /dashboard, /overview, /profile) and explicit login-state guards before each route assertion.
Keep current backend auth implementation as-is; required register/login/me/logout/role-guard API behavior is passing.
Optional cleanup: align legacy test files (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) with current API contracts (register=201, role uppercase).
critical_code_review_comments: db.py uses os.environ.get('DB_NAME', 'learnspace'); this has a fallback default and does not strictly fail fast when DB_NAME is missing.
Legacy backend regression test file still asserts old contracts (lowercase roles, 200 register) and can mislead future test runs if reused without updates.
Auth service separation is clean: UI calls authService/api layer; auth logic remains outside UI components.
seed_data_creation: Created one ephemeral TEST_ student via /api/auth/register during pytest and one UI student registration during Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file exists at /app/memory/test_credentials.md and was used. Optional auth testing docs (/app/auth_testing.md, /app/auth-testing.md) are absent. Expo web routes resolve to simplified paths (/login, /dashboard, /overview, /profile) rather than route-group URLs, so assertions should target resolved paths.
rca_of_issue: Primary blocker in this run was test-automation routing assumptions, not confirmed product failures: (1) initial selectors assumed nested input elements; direct testID fill worked, (2) route assertion expected '/(student)/...' but app resolves to '/dashboard', (3) subsequent script state checks started from unauthenticated state, causing logout element timeouts.
